final_rationale: The verdict does not change. The Actor supplied no new admissible evidence and mainly narrowed the claim to a caveated overall-readiness position. That reinterpretation is more accurate than a broad no-disclosure claim, but it does not cure the compliance defect identified in the initial report. On the stated policy text, a weakness affecting a named launch use case or contractual customer segment is material, and pending legal review means labels or prioritization framing do not resolve that issue. Because the record still shows a named committed segment, a target miss, and open legal review, certification remains unsupported as policy-compliant on the available evidence. A caveated narrative may better describe the situation, but it is not enough for compliant_with_caveats because the missing predicate is not merely disclosure wording; it is unresolved compliance authority for certifying while materiality and disclosure remain unsettled.
